Unity Developer Intern — IPage Group (Remote)
IPAGE UM Services provides geospatial, drone, mapping, and AI-driven automation solutions.
About the Internship: 6-month internship for students who have prior learning experience with Unity and are interested in working on real-time drone simulation projects with our R&D and simulation team.
Key Responsibilities:
- Work with our simulation team to build interactive drone training environments using Unity
- Develop drone movement physics, UI elements, and scene logic in C#
- Assist in integrating features like flight path drawing, crash detection, and multi-drone scenarios
- Test and optimize simulator builds for different platforms (PC/Web)
- Participate in sprint reviews, feedback sessions, and documentation
Who Can Apply:
- Must have learning experience or training in Unity and C#
- Should be familiar with basic 3D environments, animations, and game mechanics
- Passionate about simulation, gaming, or drone technology
- Must be a self-learner and team collaborator with clear communication
- Open to students, recent graduates, or self-taught developers
